# SetGadgetText <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetGadgetText:Void gadget:Int32, text:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a gadget that has text. |
| `text` | In | String | required | The new text. |

## Description

Changes the text of a gadget, like the caption of a button or label or the title of a window. Text fields and text areas have commands of their own, but this works on them too.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Text", 10, 10, 300, 100, Desktop(), 3)
lab = CreateLabel("Before", 10, 10, 200, 24, win)
SetGadgetText lab, "After"
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
